text: dsh-computer-use-en 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Windows 桌面控制插件，通过 Cordis 注册一组工具，让 agent 查看屏幕并操作鼠标、键盘和应用窗口。它支持单步及批量操作、按名称打开或聚焦应用、列出和管理窗口、读取 UI Automation 控件或窗口文字，并可读写剪贴板和切换显示器。操作结果可附带屏幕截图，设置界面提供访问模式、叠层和截图等选项。适合希望让 DSH agent 在 Windows 桌面应用中完成交互任务的用户；需要 Windows 10（2004 及以上）或 Windows 11，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-computer-use-en adds Windows desktop tools to DSH Web. Agents can inspect screenshots, click and type, batch actions, open apps, manage windows, read UI Automation controls or window text, use the clipboard, and switch displays. Windows 10 or 11 is required; no API key is configured.
想让 DSH 帮我在 Windows 桌面应用里点击和输入。
能不能让 agent 读出当前窗口的文字和控件？
I want my DSH agent to operate apps on my Windows desktop.
dsh-computer-use-en 的功能「桌面操作与批处理」：agent 可调用 computer 执行鼠标、键盘等单步操作，也可用 computer_batch 按顺序执行多个动作并返回完成后的屏幕结果。
dsh-computer-use-en 的功能「读取窗口内容」：调用 ui_elements 可查看前台或指定窗口的 UI Automation 控件及坐标，也可选择将窗口文字作为纯文本读取。
dsh-computer-use-en 使用前须知：支持视觉的模型收到操作结果时，桌面截图会保存为会话附件并随结果提供给模型；注意画面中可能包含的信息。见 lib/index.js:8592-8601、9341-9347

dsh-computer-use-en README · dsh-computer-use-en：Let DeepSeek Harness directly observe and operate your Windows desktop: view the screen, click the mouse, type on the keyboard, launch or focus apps, manage windows, read Windows UI Automation (`UIA`) trees, and read/write the clipboard. While in control, an **orange screen glow** and status pill (**"DeepSeek Harness is controlling your computer"**) appear on screen, and DeepSeek Harness minimizes into a draggable **mini progress card** in the bottom-right corner showing streaming replies and recent steps. Press **Esc** at any time to pause or resume, or click **Stop** to end the turn.

dsh-computer-use-en README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Screenshot coordinate space** | The model works directly in pixel coordinates of the latest screenshot; DPI scaling and multi-monitor offsets are converted automatically (accurate even at 150%–200% scaling). |
| **Auto-screenshot after actions** | Clicks, typing, keys, scrolling, and `wait` wait for the screen to settle (up to ~2.5s) and return a fresh screenshot automatically in a single round-trip. |
| **Batched actions (`computer_batch`)** | Execute multi-step sequences (e.g., focus field → type text → press Enter → wait for dialog → save) in a single tool call. |
| **Target controls by name (`target`)** | Pass `target` (e.g. `"Save"` or `"button:OK"`) instead of coordinates — works even for menu items or dialog buttons that appear mid-batch (waits up to 3s). |
| **Wait for conditions (`until`)** | `wait` with `until` (`"window:Save As"`, `"target:Save"`) proceeds as soon as the window or control appears (or disappears with `gone: true`). |
| **Read windows as text (`ui_elements`)** | Pass `text: true` to `ui_elements` (or `finish: "text"` to `computer_batch`) to read documents, web pages, chat replies

dsh-computer-use-en README · Installation：From GitHub Release or GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/ALAMBICCO/dsh-computer-use-en/releases/download/v0.8.1/dsh-computer-use-en-0.8.1.tgz"
```

dsh-computer-use-en README · Agent Tools：| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `computer` | Single desktop action: `screenshot`, `left_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, `right_click`, `middle_click`, `mouse_move`, `left_click_drag`, `left_mouse_down`, `left_mouse_up`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`, `hold_key`, `wait`, `zoom`, `cursor_position`. |
| `computer_batch` | Run an ordered array of actions in one round-trip, stopping on the first error and returning one settled screenshot (or window text). |
| `open_application` | Open an app by Start Menu name, desktop shortcut, `.exe` path, or URL; brings running windows to the front or restores tray apps from their notification-area icon. |
| `windows` | `list`, `focus`, `minimize`, `maximize`, `restore`, `close`, or `tidy` top-level windows. |
| `ui_elements` | Read clickable/editable UI Automation controls with screenshot-space coordinates, or pass `text: true` to read window text. |
| `clipboard` | Read or write plain text to the Windows clipboard (restored after the turn). |
| `switch_display` | List monitors or switch which display screenshots and coordinates target. |
